description: Turn a customer support email into a structured JSON ticket for a SaaS helpdesk.
input_format: The free-text body of one customer email.
output_format: A single JSON object with keys: category (one of billing, bug, account, feature_request, other), priority (low, medium, high, urgent), summary (one sentence, max 25 words), customer_sentiment (negative, neutral, positive).

seed_examples.input: Hi, I was charged twice for my Pro subscription this month. Can you refund the extra charge? Order #48213.
seed_examples.output: {"category": "billing", "priority": "high", "summary": "Customer was double-charged for the Pro subscription this month and requests a refund for order #48213.", "customer_sentiment": "negative"}

seed_examples.input: The export to CSV button does nothing in Firefox. Works fine in Chrome.
seed_examples.output: {"category": "bug", "priority": "medium", "summary": "CSV export button is unresponsive in Firefox but works in Chrome.", "customer_sentiment": "neutral"}

seed_examples.input: Our whole team is locked out since this morning, nobody can log in and we have a client demo in an hour!!!
seed_examples.output: {"category": "account", "priority": "urgent", "summary": "Entire team cannot log in since this morning, blocking a client demo in one hour.", "customer_sentiment": "negative"}

seed_examples.input: Love the new dashboard! Would be great if we could also schedule reports to go out by email every Monday.
seed_examples.output: {"category": "feature_request", "priority": "low", "summary": "Customer likes the new dashboard and requests scheduled weekly email reports.", "customer_sentiment": "positive"}

seed_examples.input: How do I change the email address on my account? I switched jobs.
seed_examples.output: {"category": "account", "priority": "low", "summary": "Customer asks how to change the email address on their account after switching jobs.", "customer_sentiment": "neutral"}

seed_examples.input: Your API has been returning 500 errors on /v2/orders for the last 20 minutes. Our checkout is down.
seed_examples.output: {"category": "bug", "priority": "urgent", "summary": "API endpoint /v2/orders has returned 500 errors for 20 minutes, taking the customer's checkout down.", "customer_sentiment": "negative"}

seed_examples.input: Can I get an invoice with our VAT number on it? We need it for accounting. VAT: SE556677889901.
seed_examples.output: {"category": "billing", "priority": "medium", "summary": "Customer requests an invoice including VAT number SE556677889901 for accounting.", "customer_sentiment": "neutral"}

seed_examples.input: I cancelled my plan last week but I still see it as active and I'm worried I'll be charged again.
seed_examples.output: {"category": "billing", "priority": "high", "summary": "Plan still shows as active a week after cancellation and customer fears another charge.", "customer_sentiment": "negative"}

seed_examples.input: Is there a dark mode? My eyes hurt in the evening lol
seed_examples.output: {"category": "feature_request", "priority": "low", "summary": "Customer asks whether a dark mode is available for evening use.", "customer_sentiment": "neutral"}

seed_examples.input: The mobile app crashes every time I open the calendar tab. iPhone 15, iOS 19.2, app version 4.8.1.
seed_examples.output: {"category": "bug", "priority": "high", "summary": "Mobile app crashes when opening the calendar tab on iPhone 15, iOS 19.2, app 4.8.1.", "customer_sentiment": "negative"}

seed_examples.input: Just wanted to say your support team was amazing yesterday, Sara fixed my issue in 5 minutes. Thanks!
seed_examples.output: {"category": "other", "priority": "low", "summary": "Customer thanks the support team, praising Sara for resolving their issue in five minutes.", "customer_sentiment": "positive"}

seed_examples.input: We need SSO with Okta before we can roll this out to 400 employees. Is that on the roadmap?
seed_examples.output: {"category": "feature_request", "priority": "medium", "summary": "Customer needs Okta SSO before rolling out to 400 employees and asks about the roadmap.", "customer_sentiment": "neutral"}

seed_examples.input: 2FA codes aren't arriving by SMS. I've tried 5 times. I can't get into my account.
seed_examples.output: {"category": "account", "priority": "high", "summary": "SMS two-factor codes are not arriving after five attempts, locking the customer out.", "customer_sentiment": "negative"}

seed_examples.input: Why did my price go up from 12 to 15 euros? Nobody told me about this.
seed_examples.output: {"category": "billing", "priority": "medium", "summary": "Customer questions an unannounced price increase from 12 to 15 euros.", "customer_sentiment": "negative"}

seed_examples.input: Search results are really slow when I have more than 10k records, takes like 30 seconds.
seed_examples.output: {"category": "bug", "priority": "medium", "summary": "Search takes around 30 seconds when the account has more than 10,000 records.", "customer_sentiment": "neutral"}

eval_criteria: Output is a single valid JSON object with exactly the four keys; category and priority are from the allowed sets and match the email; summary is faithful, specific and at most 25 words; sentiment matches the tone.
